title: Ceramic production and management of the fire between late Ubaid and LC1. The potter’s kilns of Tell Feres al-Sharqi
version: Proceedings of the 8th International Congress on the Archaeology of the Ancient Near East, vol. 3, pp. 187–200.
lineage: Original workshop account by a co-investigator in the later wheel study, with the same excavation underlying both accounts.

passages.note: Reports a multi-phase late Ubaid pottery workshop with kilns and potters’ implements, including two ceramic disc fragments interpreted as possible turntables.
